explanation: The check in verify must reject a nonce already in seen; removing it would let a token be replayed. #123 is an issue reference for this hazard.
Call ensure_key_salt before initializing KeyManager. If salt setup fails, startup must abort. There are no external references.
Before allocating buf with topN elements, keep topN at or below maxSimpleTopN so the resulting slice stays at or below 1 MiB. Both names are code identifiers; there are no external references.
When meta.abi_version is missing, this expression must produce None rather than silently selecting the current ABI. #1784 is an issue reference.
The drop-in written under /etc/tlp.d/ can be overridden because TLP reads /etc/tlp.conf last. Both paths are configuration file locations.

The set_key configuration assumes TLP version 1.10 or later; _AC, _BAT, and _SAV denote profile suffixes. Leaving the _AC setting unset preserves the GNOME Performance toggle. TLP and GNOME are the external programs involved.
This JsonException handler returns null because the caller logs a warning for a parse error; throwing here would bypass that handling. There are no external references.

When an AllowedTools set is in force, RemoveSkipPermissions must strip --dangerously-skip-permissions from args because that flag bypasses --allowedTools. AllowedTools and RemoveSkipPermissions are code identifiers; the two dashed names are command-line flags.

For the dead-code decision made by thunk_is_dead, consult the verdict table in rust/xray-core/src/compiler/graph_preamble.rs at the is_definitely_dead_code symbol. The path and symbol identify the related implementation.
repos_skipped is currently set to zero; the outstanding task is to calculate it from the domains-to-repos mapping. #874 is the issue tracking that work.
The index.regex_query call uses a linear-time DFA for regex matching, so the query does not incur regex backtracking. regex_query is the method being described.

Changes to the token-family table schema here must be coordinated with RefreshTokenSqliteBackend._ensure_schema in src/storage/refresh_token_backend.py. That path and symbol identify the other schema definition.
MAX_BATCH is capped at 500 because the vendor's batch API accepts no more than 500 items. doc:vendor-api#limits points to the limits section of the vendor API documentation.

Keep these Status values in sync with STATUS_LABELS in web/src/status.ts. Their iota order assigns stored integer values, so reordering them would change what existing integers mean. #88 is an issue reference.
The index columns must stay in the order tenant_id, then created_at, because that order matches the orders_by_tenant query. orders_by_tenant names the related query.
TList.Add must preserve the rule that FCount never exceeds the length of FItems; Grow is the operation that maintains that capacity. FCount, FItems, and Grow are code identifiers.
In close, call _flush before closing the sink because closing it drops _buf. _flush and _buf name the relevant method and buffer field.

Because userPath comes from a request, resolve it under workspaceRoot and reject paths containing .. that escape that root. userPath and workspaceRoot are the input and root variables; .. means a parent-directory path component.
unsure: The comment requires rejection of escapes, but the shown resolve(...).normalize() line alone does not show that rejection.

explanation: Drain the ring before freeing buf. Otherwise the IRQ handler could access freed memory. ring_drain and buf are the relevant function and buffer; #2201 is an issue reference.

Reserve space for n items before appending so allocation happens once; prior push_back growth accounted for 40% of the measured profile. doc:perf-notes#ingest points to the ingest section of the performance notes.
Use HOLDLOCK on this SQL Server MERGE because concurrent upserts can race without it. doc:mssql-merge#concurrency points to the concurrency section of the MERGE documentation.

Use an autonomous transaction for the audit operation so its row survives even if the caller rolls back its own transaction. PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION is the SQL directive implementing that choice.

This migration creates a replacement table because SQLite ALTER TABLE cannot drop the needed constraints directly. doc:sqlite-alter#otheralter points to the relevant SQLite ALTER TABLE documentation section.
The loop scans every five seconds because NFS mounts do not emit the inotify events this code would need for event-based scanning. NFS and inotify identify the filesystem and notification mechanism.

Keep the awaited run calls in a for...of loop. Using an async callback inside forEach would let its errors escape the surrounding try/catch. forEach and for...of are the JavaScript iteration forms being compared.

The frame returned by read_frame must contain no more than MAX_FRAME bytes; the decoder is responsible for rejecting larger frames. Vec<u8> is the frame's byte-vector type, and MAX_FRAME is the size limit.
Register drainHook before pool.start() so a SIGTERM can trigger draining of the pool after it starts. drainHook and pool.start are code identifiers; SIGTERM is the termination signal.

The fixed retry delay in backoff is temporary. Move the policy into configuration; the task is done when Default in internal/retry/policy.go reads that configuration. The path and symbol identify where completion should be checked.
Issue #412 contains the full matrix of transitions among the LeaseState values shown here. The issue number is a reference for interpreting allowed state changes.

Pass the token to tool login through standard input, never as an argument, because ps can show command-line arguments to other users. TOKEN is the shell variable holding the token; --token-stdin is the tool flag selecting standard input.
Create app_reader before granting it SELECT access because migration 042 assumes that role exists. app_reader is the role name, and 042 identifies the dependent migration.
Make on_event safe to run more than once for the same webhook: Stripe retries webhook delivery for three days. doc:stripe#webhook-retries points to the retry section of the Stripe documentation.

Compare the supplied and expected MACs with hmac.Equal so comparison takes constant time; using == could reveal information through timing. hmac.Equal is the comparison function, and sig and expected are the values compared.
Build CodeGraph once per index, at a cost proportional to the number of edges; doing that work for each query would repeat the cost. CodeGraph::build is the graph construction method.

The packed TCustomerRec layout is used by saved .dat files. If its layout changes, bump FILE_VERSION so the file format change is recognized. TCustomerRec and FILE_VERSION are code identifiers; .dat identifies the saved-file extension.
Change MSG_MAX and MSG_MAX_WIRE together. MSG_MAX_WIRE is defined in proto/messages.h and represents the coupled wire-format limit.

The handler relies on authMiddleware having run first, which guarantees session.userId is non-null. authMiddleware is the middleware that establishes the guarantee; session.userId is the field it guarantees.

Synchronize on cache so checking and then inserting happen atomically. A ConcurrentHashMap alone would not make that multi-step operation atomic. cache is the locked object and ConcurrentHashMap is the alternative collection type.

Validate the user-provided repository alias against the registry before using it in a path join, to prevent an untrusted alias from selecting an unintended path. validate_alias is the validation function; #1996 is an issue reference.
Payment Amount must be nonnegative. Represent refunds as separate rows whose Kind is 'R', rather than as negative amounts. Amount and Kind are table columns, and 'R' is the refund kind value.
Set stop_ before calling worker_.join(); otherwise the worker may keep running and join can block forever. stop_ and worker_ are the stop flag and worker identifiers.

The limiter rate is chosen for GitHub's stated limit of 5,000 API requests per hour per token; one request every 720 milliseconds equals that hourly rate. doc:github-rest#rate-limits points to the REST API rate-limit documentation.

Stop the cidx service before installing its replacement binary, because replacing a running binary can fail with “Text file busy.” cidx is the service and binary name; /usr/local/bin/cidx is the installation path.
Do not share _lease across jobs: a shared CredentialLease could expose one user's credentials to another job. _lease and CredentialLease are the field and its type; #77 is an issue reference.

Keep ids at 999 elements or fewer when building this DELETE statement, because its bound variables are subject to SQLite's per-statement limit. ids is the collection being bound and marks supplies its placeholders.
If cgroup.create fails because of a bad memory estimate, log the error and let the job continue instead of aborting it. cgroup.create is the containment setup call and warn logs its error.
The /v1/jobs legacy route is scheduled for removal. #530 is the issue tracking that task; /v1 is the legacy route prefix.
Consult the session-model section of ADR 007 for the reason SessionRegistry keeps sessions per browser tab. doc:adr-007#session-model is that document anchor.
This partial index covers rows with released_at IS NULL so active-lease lookups by credential_id are about 30 times faster. released_at and credential_id are the filter and indexed columns.
Keep EVENT_TYPES synchronized with EVENT_LABELS in web/src/events.ts and with docs/events.md. The path and symbol identify the UI labels; the second path identifies the event documentation.

Sweep must not delete a bucket merely because it exceeded IdleTTL; it must also be full at now. Deleting a partly refilled bucket would recreate it with fresh capacity before its proper refill time. TestSweepKeepsBucketsThatWouldNotBeFullYet is the test covering this rule.

Allow a token when b.tokens is within eps of 1 because repeated fractional refill calculations can leave the stored value slightly below 1. TestFractionalRefillIsPreservedAcrossRequests covers that behavior.

The double TypeScript cast treats insert.get's result as TransferRow because this RETURNING insert is expected to yield a row; the author chose that assertion instead of a null check. TransferRow is the expected row type.

After opening the database and enabling foreign keys, query sqlite_schema to force a schema read. The comment says PRAGMAs alone do not read the file, while this query detects a file that is not a database. sqlite_schema is SQLite's schema table.

Where CPython provides set_int_max_str_digits, disable its integer-string digit limit before running main; otherwise conversions beyond 4,300 digits can raise ValueError. CPython 3.9.14+ identifies the affected version range, and set_int_max_str_digits is the Python API.
Keep the trigger's 'equity' account-name literal synchronized with EQUITY_ACCOUNT in src/ledger.ts. The path and symbol identify the corresponding code constant.

Recheck isApplied while holding the transaction's write lock, even though the migration was found in the earlier pending scan. Another migrator could apply it between the scan and this point, causing a double application. isApplied and pending identify the check and earlier scan result.
